title: 专题：AI 问题卡（AI 需要澄清时输入框位置换成可点的问题卡；问题结束回合、回答是下一条消息；第二段扩到模糊请求）
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ④ cross-repo topic parent (tracking). Source: maintainer. Jack, 2026-11-27, verbatim: 「我们有这个问题确认的流程吗」 (06:54Z, Attio screenshot); 「用户体验相关的非常关键，要启动，也要参考一下 tweety 的代码」 and 「我知道，这个是一个单独的专题」 (06:56Z); 「你只处理 cloud 的任务，其他任务都交给 objectstack 座位哦」 (07:51Z); decision card 「按 v2 立卡，顶替输入框」 (08:05Z); 「交给 objectstack #3」 (08:06Z).
Owner: the objectstack children go to **repo:objectstack#3**; the cloud children (Q3, Q4) stay with seat epic:#5027#1 (objectstack-ai/cloud#5027).
Business reason: when the AI needs a clarification today it writes the question as plain text and the user must type the answer. A clickable question card (as in Attio and Twenty) turns that into one click, so ambiguous asks get answered instead of abandoned.
Grading: area:ai · tracking · p1 (stage 1 children p1, stage 2 p2).
Dedupe: searched `question card`, `ask_which`, `AskQuestion`: #37690 segment 3 item 3 「ask_which 选项卡」 is taken over by this topic (linked there); #34578 (ask_which label) unrelated. No duplicate.

## 维护者速读
- **是什么**：AI 需要你澄清时，输入框的位置换成一张可点的问题卡：问题加粗，选项带一行说明，最后一项「自己输入…」，底部 跳过 / 上一题 / 下一题·发送。单题点一下就发。
- **关键判断**：不做服务端暂停，不改 ADR-0013。问题照现在 `ask_which` 的方式结束回合，回答是下一条普通消息。代价：问和答各算一次按天配额回合。
- **分两段**：第一段只做卡片（现有问数歧义提问马上有卡，AI 行为和评测不变），p1；第二段让 AI 对"帮我分析一下"这类模糊请求也问，要过评测门槛，p2。
- **要你做什么**：无。

## Decisions
- **D1 No server-side pause.** The question tool ends the turn as `ask_which` does today (`ctx.requestTurnEnd(reply)`, cloud `service-ai-studio/src/tools/ask-which.tool.ts:99-119`); reply = question + bullet list (for model history, conversation list and evals). The tool result carries a structured envelope; the console draws the card from it. The answer is an ordinary user message (new turnId) sent through `onSendMessage`. No new turn state, no answer endpoint, no rewrite of stored tool results, no ADR-0013 change. Accepted costs: question and answer each count as a daily-quota turn; the server does not know which question a message answers; two tabs can both answer; the local-cache fallback shows the question as text.
- **D2 Envelope in spec** (Q1). **D3 When a card shows** (pure function, Q2b). **D4 Card and interaction** (Q2a/Q2b): the card takes the composer's place (Attio layout, Jack 08:05Z). **D5 Tool**: keep `ask_which`; stage 2 extends its input (Q3) and adds a separate "ask for direction" skill (Q4). **D6 Eval gates** (Q3, Q4).
- Learn from Twenty's design only; never copy its code (AGPL).

## Children
| Card | Repo · owner | What | Size | Prio | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | objectstack · repo:objectstack#3 | spec envelope, legacy compatibility, parser, limits, tests, api-surface and docs | S | p1 | — |
| Q2a | objectstack · repo:objectstack#3 | `QuestionCard` pure component | M | p1 | — (start now) |
| Q2b | objectstack · repo:objectstack#3 | wiring: envelope detection, `findPendingQuestion`, composer gate, in-thread summary, no regenerate, skip marks; brightrule smoke after release | M | p1 | Q1, Q2a, #37799; soft order with #37729, #37861 |
| Q3 | cloud · epic:#5027#1 | `ask_which` new input and envelope, preface, no-number rule; eval gate | M | p2 | Q1 in the cloud pin |
| Q4 | cloud · epic:#5027#1 | "ask for direction" skill; eval additions; gate | M–L | p2 | Q3; entry topic #37853 `context.focus` behaviour |

Stage 1 = Q1 + Q2a + Q2b; stage 2 = Q3 + Q4. Q2a, Q1 and Q3 can start in parallel. Card numbers are in the audit comment below.

## Relations
- #37799 (split A): Q2b Blocked-by (adds a field to the split-out `chat/types.ts`).
- #37803 (split C): no dependency (sending uses `onSendMessage`; both message mappers already carry the tool `result`: `AiChatPage.tsx:249-250,284-288`, `mapMessages.ts:490,523`).
- #37729 (split B): soft order; the summary is drawn in the message layer, not in `renderToolDetail`.
- #37861 (entry C5): soft order, whoever lands later rebases. Joint acceptance: with the card shown the answer still sends `context.focus`; after the card closes the chip is still there.
- #37860 / #37855 (entry C4 / A5): a pending question is not an exception: a user-initiated close then 「问 AI」 opens a new conversation; the old question stays in history as past (row added on #37855).
- #37690 segment 3: item 3 taken over here; item 4 (approval card in the composer's place) reuses this topic's composer gate.

## Topic acceptance
1. An ambiguous data question shows the card in the console; one click gets the number; full screen, narrow drawer and mobile drawer all work.
2. A half-typed draft from during the turn survives the card appearing and a skip.
3. A message queued during the turn: no card, the queued message is sent.
4. Unanswered then refresh / reopen: the card is still there; answered ones show the collapsed summary and the answer.
5. The pending-question message has no "regenerate"; shared read-only pages show no card.
6. Old conversations' text `ask_which` answers render as before, no error.
7. 「帮我分析一下」 on a blank page shows a card; after answering the AI analyses as chosen (stage 2).
8. Q3 and Q4 eval gates pass.
9. Keyboard works end to end without stealing composer focus; Arabic is right-to-left; screen readers read the question number, options and "a question is waiting".

## Risks
1. More clarifying questions (stage 2): covered by the D6 gates and by the new skill being removable on its own.
2. Quota doubles for asked turns; accepted.
3. Single-click send mis-taps: single question only; two questions stop on 「发送」.
4. Two tabs answering twice: no server state to prevent it; low harm.
